title: 建築のしくみ
subtitle: Introduction of the Structure
educationalGoal: Architectures and cities are assessed from a variety of perspectives, contained design, and convenience. The course provides an overview of structures, their construction, and the special qualities of materials used for architecture. Students learn about wooden buildings made of regional products and understand the connection between architecture and its location.
advice: Japanese wooden structures have been built for a long time. Students learn how to construct traditional wooden structures, steel structures, and reinforced concrete structures.
